upg13:1.1: Taṅhaṅkara, the Great Hero, Medhaṅkara, one of Great Fame,
upg13:1.2: Saraṇaṅkara, the World’s Friend, Dīpaṅkara, Resplendant One.
upg13:2.1: Koṅḍañña, the People’s Leader, Maṅgala, the Foremost of Men,
upg13:2.2: Sumana, Happy and Wise, Revata, Increases Delight.
upg13:3.1: Sobhita, Endowed with Virtue, Anomadassī, Supreme Man,
upg13:3.2: Paduma, the Light of the World, Nārada, the Noble Leader.
upg13:4.1: Padumuttara, the Essential, Sumedha, Highest amongst Men,
upg13:4.2: Sujāta, Highest of All Worlds, Piyadassī, Foremost Person.
upg13:5.2: Siddhattha, Matchless in the World, Tissa, Giver of Full Restraint.
upg13:6.1: Phussa, who gives Awakening, Vipassī the Matchless One,
upg13:6.2: Sikhī, Teacher of Benefit, Vessabhū, who gave Happiness.
upg13:7.2: Kassapa, Endowed with Glory, Gotama, the Noble Sakyan.
upg13:8.1: Through their truth, virtue, and the strength of their patience and friendliness,
upg13:8.2: may these (Buddhas) always protect you with good health and happiness!
upg13:9.1: These are the twenty-eight Buddhas, who fulfilled the ten perfections,
upg13:9.2: Having defeated Māra in battle, they attained to Buddhahood,
upg13:9.3: By this declaration of the truth may you have the blessing of success!
